svg.title: What the log entry keeps from the certificate
svg.desc: Left, the TBSCertificate fields with their sizes in the toy: version 5, serial 9, signature algorithm 12, issuer 22, validity 32, subject 26, subject public key info 1,334 bytes, extensions 51. Right, the TBSCertificateLogEntry: no serial, no signature algorithm, and the 1,334-byte public key replaced by its algorithm identifier and a 32-byte SHA-256 hash. The whole log entry is 187 bytes.

text.tspan: 187 bytes per certificate in the log
the serial is the log position;
leaf hash = SHA-256(0x00 || MTCLogEntry): the browser recomputes it from the certificate it was given.
